meta.title: Viral composition by body compartment
meta.purpose: Feeds the "virus type" variable of the body-compartment heatmap.
meta.what_this_is: Literature EXPECTATIONS with per-site citations, not measurements and not ViroForge generator output.
meta.phage_fraction_definition: phage / (phage + eukaryotic virus), abundance-weighted on the classified fraction. Unknown-host genomes excluded.
meta.catalog_verdict_note: Compares ViroForge generated data against the expectation. A bad grade flags the CATALOGUE, not the expectation.

gut.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Overwhelmingly phage-dominated (~85-95%); eukaryotic virus low single digits.
gut.expected_na_type: Predominantly dsDNA (tailed phages) + ssDNA (Microviridae); RNA minor.

catalog_verdict.text: PLAUSIBLE / GOOD. phage 88.5% / euk 3% / DNA 90.3% match consensus. Top family Suoliviridae is a valid crAss-like Crassvirales family. No red flags.

citations.title: The human gut virome: composition, colonization, interactions, and impacts on human health.
citations.supports: Healthy adult gut virome dominated by bacteriophages, predominantly Crassvirales (crAss-like) in industrialized populations; large dark-matter fraction.

citations.title: A Previously Undescribed Highly Prevalent Phage Identified in a Danish Enteric Virome Catalog.
citations.supports: Gut viromes of 91 healthy subjects dominated by phages; crAss-like phage among the two most prevalent worldwide.

oral.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Strongly bacteriophage-dominated (vast majority of reads phage); eukaryotic viruses minor (~10-25%).

catalog_verdict.text: MATCH with one top-family flag. Phage dominance (66%) correct direction (arguably low side); DNA-only correct. Flag: top family Microviridae, but saliva viromes are dominated by tailed Caudovirales (Siphoviridae), not Microviridae.

citations.title: Evidence of a robust resident bacteriophage population revealed through analysis of the human salivary virome.
citations.supports: Healthy saliva viral communities dominated by bacteriophages; DNA virome.

citations.title: Altered oral viral ecology in association with periodontal disease.
citations.supports: Saliva and oral biofilm viromes composed largely of bacteriophage; predators of bacteria dominate.

skin.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Phage-DOMINANT (~80-95%+ of identifiable reads); eukaryotic papilloma/polyoma a small minority; large phage dark matter.

catalog_verdict.text: NOT PLAUSIBLE / likely error. Observed phage 0%, euk 49%, unknown-fam 51%. Skin sebaceous virome is bacteriophage-DOMINATED (Cutibacterium/Staphylococcus/Corynebacterium phages). 0% phage contradicts primary literature; phage genomes appear missing or unlabeled.

citations.title: The human skin double-stranded DNA virome: topographical and temporal diversity, genetic enrichment, and dynamic associations with the host microbiome.
citations.supports: Healthy skin dsDNA VLP virome dominated by temperate tailed bacteriophages.

citations.title: The persistence and stabilization of auxiliary genes in the human skin virome.
citations.supports: Cutaneous bacteriophage populations across 60 subjects mainly tailed Caudovirales phages.

throat.proxy_note: Nasopharynx used as proxy for upper airway / throat.
throat.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Eukaryote-dominated, led by Anelloviridae; bacteriophages present but comparatively low in health.
throat.expected_na_type: Predominantly DNA (Anelloviridae ssDNA); small RNA fraction (rhinovirus).

catalog_verdict.text: MISMATCH (balance inverted + wrong top taxon). Observed phage 50 > euk 35 (phage-dominated); healthy nasopharynx is eukaryote/Anellovirus-dominated. Top family should be Anelloviridae, not a phage family (Aliceevansviridae). Caveat: strongest evidence pediatric/asthma cohorts, but Anellovirus dominance robust.

citations.title: Metagenomic analysis of viral genetic diversity in respiratory samples from children with severe acute respiratory infection in China.
citations.supports: Respiratory virome of children without severe infection dominated by Anelloviridae.

citations.title: Respiratory eukaryotic virome expansion and bacteriophage deficiency characterize childhood asthma.
citations.supports: Nasopharyngeal virome dominated by eukaryotic viruses; Anelloviridae most abundant family; bacteriophages low.

citations.title: Characterization of the nasopharyngeal viral microbiome from children with community-acquired pneumonia but negative for Luminex xTAG respiratory viral panel assay detection.
citations.supports: Nasopharyngeal virome dominated by eukaryotic respiratory viruses (Paramyxo/Herpes/Anello/Polyoma).

vaginal.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Phage-DOMINANT; eukaryotic viruses only ~4% of reads (Jakobsen 2020).

catalog_verdict.text: PARTIAL match with family-rank/proxy problem. Phage-present DNA-only structure is directionally correct, but eukaryotic fraction (25%) far above ~4%; top family Herelleviridae is a proxy artifact (large Firmicutes phages, not temperate Lactobacillus siphophages). Consistent with documented dairy-proxy limitation.

citations.title: Characterization of the Vaginal DNA Virome in Health and Dysbiosis.
citations.supports: Majority of vaginal viruses are dsDNA bacteriophages; eukaryotic viruses only ~4% of reads.

citations.title: Cervicovaginal DNA Virome Alterations Are Associated with Genital Inflammation and Microbiota Composition.
citations.supports: Lactobacillus bacteriophages closely associated with Lactobacillus abundance.

blood.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Eukaryote-DOMINANT and Anellovirus-dominant (~97% of viral reads, Cebria-Mendoza 2021); herpesviruses minor; phage ~0.

catalog_verdict.text: PARTIAL match with clear TOP-FAMILY RANK ERROR. Eukaryote-dominant DNA-based phage-~0 structure correct, but top family Orthoherpesviridae is WRONG: healthy plasma should be Anelloviridae-DOMINATED, herpesviruses secondary.

citations.title: Deep viral blood metagenomics reveals extensive anellovirus diversity in healthy humans.
citations.supports: Anellovirus sequences ~97% of total viral reads in 120 healthy donors.

citations.title: Human Anelloviruses: Influence of Demographic Factors, Recombination, and Worldwide Diversity.
citations.supports: Anelloviruses the major and most diverse component of the healthy human virome; detected in 86% of blood donors.

citations.title: Temporal dynamics of the lung and plasma viromes in lung transplant recipients.
citations.supports: In plasma, Anelloviridae most abundant, followed by Herpesviridae and Coronaviridae.

lung.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Eukaryote-dominated, led by Anelloviridae/TTV; phages of respiratory bacteria secondary.

catalog_verdict.text: MISMATCH on top taxon and unknown fraction (euk-dominance direction correct). euk 47 > phage 20 correct; but top family Unknown where Anelloviridae expected; unknown-fam 33.6% too high and suspiciously near-identical to CF 33.4% (shared-default tell).

citations.title: Viral metagenomics reveal blooms of anelloviruses in the respiratory tract of lung transplant recipients.
citations.supports: All BAL samples (including healthy controls) contained anelloviruses; anelloviruses define the respiratory DNA virome.

citations.title: The Perioperative Lung Transplant Virome: Torque Teno Viruses Are Elevated in Donor Lungs and Show Divergent Dynamics in Primary Graft Dysfunction.
citations.supports: Lung/BAL virome mainly Torque teno viruses (Anellovirus) and bacteriophages of respiratory bacteria.

citations.title: Lower Airway Virology in Health and Disease-From Invaders to Symbionts.
citations.supports: Review: lower airway virome includes Anelloviridae, Herpesviridae, bacteriophages (secondary support).

urine.expected_phage_vs_eukaryote: Phage present and usually the largest identifiable fraction by richness, with a substantial signature eukaryotic DNA-virus signal (HPV, BK/JC).

catalog_verdict.text: PARTIAL match. Top family Papillomaviridae well supported (HPV ~95% prevalence); DNA-only correct; Polyomaviridae expected. But phage at 14% with euk 68% likely under-represents bacteriophages.

citations.title: The human urine virome in association with urinary tract infections.
citations.supports: Most identifiable urine viruses were bacteriophages; HPV in 95% of subjects.

citations.title: Detecting viral genomes in the female urinary microbiome.
citations.supports: Female bladder virome contains bacteriophages and the eukaryotic JC polyomavirus.

citations.title: Longitudinal alterations in the urinary virome of kidney transplant recipients are influenced by BK viremia and patient sex.
citations.supports: Urinary virome carries anelloviruses and BK polyomavirus.
